messages:
ashwin: FYI: long-run toolloop test (100 sessions, streaming) shows steady RSS climb ~20MB/min after ~30m. Not a one-off, repro on both amsterdam and us-west pools.

maria: ack. can you paste the run command and a quick top / pmap snapshot?

ashwin: run: `./bench_toolloop --sessions 100 --seq-len 32768 --iter 10000 --mode streaming`
ashwin: pmap (tail):
```
5567f8a  6.2G writeable/private   6.2G   /opt/redwood/bin/runtime
```
ashwin: jemalloc: active: 6.0G, metadata: 48M, retained: 320M

jen: interesting — that pattern (slow linear growth after warmup) usually points at long-lived KV residency, not immediate leak in allocator. any kv cache stats?

ashwin: kv metrics at t=1h:
- sessions: 100
- kv_pages_total: 1.2M
- kv_pages_in_use: 1.18M
- eviction_count: 680
- pagewalk_ops: 42k
- avg_pagewalk_latency_ms: 0.9 -> 4.8 (rises over time)

sam: avg pagewalk latency jump from <1ms to ~5ms seems key. could be fragmentation causing longer chains and more kernel pagewalks. did you get a perf trace?

ashwin: ran perf record on a reproduction (shorter, 1h) — attached flame was noisy but kernel pagewalk syscalls and some page-table rwlock waits showed up. perf report snippet:
```
  12.3%  runtime  [kernel] page_fault
   9.1%  runtime  runtime::kv_pagewalk_loop
   3.4%  runtime  anon_madvise
```

maria: @ashwin can you run `kv-stats dump-residency --format csv` and also `heap-snapshot` (jemalloc) at 10m intervals (0, 10, 30, 60)? want to see growth shape.

ashwin: will do. quick dumps show repeated small slabs pinned per-session: avg pages/session = 11800 -> 11850 -> 11890 over 1hr. suggests per-session pagechain keeps growing, not global leak.

jen: hypothesis: a refcount or pin stamp on certain page types isn't being cleared when we rotate active tool loop frames. maybe the page-coalescer failed to unpin tail segments when prefix reused.

sam: can we try a forced compact path to see if reclaimed? i.e. `kv-admin compaction --aggressive` during run and watch RSS.

ashwin: did that — compaction frees ~120MB immediately but growth resumes. so pages are reachable (not orphaned) and compaction helps temporarily.

perf-bot: deploy 4898765501: test patch kv/evict: reduce min_hold_ms from 60000 -> 5000 (canary cluster)

maria: that patch is a blunt instrument but useful as mitigation. any perf regressions from rapid churn?

ashwin: ran canary for 15m: memory stabilizes but TPS dropped 6% under bursty load. batching heuristics likely sensitive to earlier hold window.

jen: ok this reads like a correctness/performance tradeoff: we can reduce page hold to control long-context growth, but it impacts steady-state throughput. prefer fix the root (pin logic).

sam: agree. next step: add instrumentation in the page-pin/unpin hotpath to log stack-id + page-type on pin/unpin mismatch. small patch:
```
if (pin_count == 0 && trying_unpin) {
  log_warn("unpinned zero", stack_id(), page_type);
}
```

ashwin: i've instrumented on a local repro. saw ~120 stack-id mismatches over 30m. most from toolloop module `toolchain::frame_rotate` path.

maria: can you open a tiny PR with instrumentation + test that reproduces mismatch via unit harness? we'll run CI and extended perf.

ashwin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6523 — includes repro harness and opt-out flag `KV_PIN_DIAGNOSTICS=1`

jen: nice. also add a short-term runtime config: `kv.max_session_pages=16384` (lower than default) so customers running massive streaming can opt down and avoid slow growth while we patch.

ashwin: will add config + docs. also adding evict policy tweak to prefer coalesced tail-first to avoid creating long chains.

sam: timeline? can we have a perf-tested fix and rollout (canary -> prod) in 3 business days?

maria: 3 days seems tight but doable if PR is small and tests pass. priorities: correctness test, perf run (1h), and regression matrix across small/large batch sizes.

ashwin: plan: today instrument, tomorrow run CI & 1h perf, day-after address any regressions and prepare canary.

jen: :thumbsup: please tag me on PR review and paste the 1h perf graphs in this thread.

ashwin: will do. interim note: reproduction command and minimal mitigate flags in case SRE needs to triage customer incidents:
```
KV_PIN_DIAGNOSTICS=1 KV_MAX_SESSION_PAGES=16384 ./bench_toolloop --sessions 100 --seq-len 32768 --mode streaming
```

maria: thanks — also filing a short postmortem template in /incidents if we find customer impact.

ashwin: update: initial perf run (1h) passed, compaction + patch reduces steady growth from 20MB/min to ~2MB/min. attaching CSVs (uploaded to /s3/rrun/4898765432/).

sam: great. next: schedule a canary with reduced min_hold_ms + fix for pin mismatch to see combined effect.

jen: moving to PR review. good work folks.

maria: :eyes: followups: add unit test for pagewalk path and a small e2e reproducer script in tools/bench, and an ops doc for kv tuning knobs.

ashwin: noted — will add tests + docs in follow-up PR. thanks all.
